career_ladder.note: Supervisory technical cadre responsible for operation, maintenance, distribution, and substation management in Uttar Pradesh Power Corporation Limited (UPPCL) and distribution companies (Discoms: DVVNL, MVVNL, PVVNL, PuVVNL, KESCO) and transmission corporation (UPPTCL). JEs advance to Assistant Engineer via departmental quota and seniority.

exam_scheme.note: Selection is conducted via a single-stage Computer Based Test (CBT) consisting of 200 objective MCQs for 200 marks of 3 hours duration, followed by Document Verification. Minimum 30% qualifying marks required.

financial_package.note: Junior Engineers in UPPCL are placed in Pay Level 7 (Entry Basic Pay ₹44,900) under the 7th CPC aligned UPPCL Revised Pay Matrix. Employees receive Dearness Allowance, House Rent Allowance, technical allowance, and concessional power units.
financial_package.pay_source_label: UPPCL Revised Pay Rules 2016 Level 7 & Advt 07/VSA/2021/JE
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Level 7 entry basic pay of ₹44,900 with 58% DA (₹26,042), HRA (₹4,500 to ₹9,000 based on urban classification), technical allowance, electricity concession, mobile allowance, net of 10% NPS deduction (₹7,094) and group insurance.
official_perks: Dearness Allowance (DA) revised bi-annually per UP PSU regulations
House Rent Allowance (HRA) or official quarter in electricity sub-station colony
Concessional electricity unit allowance per UPPCL corporate guidelines
Technical allowance, mobile reimbursement, and local travel allowance
National Pension System (NPS) with 14% employer matching contribution
Medical reimbursement under UPPCL Employee Health Scheme
